docs_chrome_close_menu: Accessible name of the close button of the docs drawer on phones.
docs_chrome_documentation: Accessible name of the docs sidebar and heading of the phone drawer.
docs_chrome_edit: Link at the end of a docs page that opens the page's source file on GitHub for editing.
docs_chrome_group_guides: Docs sidebar group: docs/_nav.json group titled Guides (one page per feature).
docs_chrome_group_help: Docs sidebar group: docs/_nav.json group titled Help (troubleshooting, FAQ).
docs_chrome_group_project: Docs sidebar group: docs/_nav.json group titled Project (architecture, contributing, releases).
docs_chrome_group_reference: Docs sidebar group: docs/_nav.json group titled Reference (CLI, configuration).
docs_chrome_group_start_here: Docs sidebar group: docs/_nav.json group titled Start here (introduction, getting started, installation).
docs_chrome_next: Small label above the title of the next docs page, in the links at the end of a page. pt-BR agrees with página. i18n-distinct: the next page of the docs (feminine, agrees with página), not the Next step of the desktop tour.
docs_chrome_on_this_page: Heading and accessible name of the table of contents of a docs page.
docs_chrome_previous: Small label above the title of the previous docs page, in the links at the end of a page.
docs_chrome_search_placeholder: Placeholder of the docs search box.
